unparsedCards.name: Shitty Xmas Present
segments: Put a Cracked Bauble from outside the game on top of target hero's deck.

unparsedCards.name: Spirit of Christmas
segments: Each hero chooses another hero. The chosen hero creates an Agility, Might, Vigor, and Gold token.

unparsedCards.name: Cracker Bauble
segments: When this is pitched, you and target opponent randomly choose opposite ends of this and pull them until this breaks in half. Then each hero creates the token on the back of their half, and this ceases to exist.

unparsedCards.name: Ruu'di, Gem Keeper
segments: You may only have PSA graded cards in your deck.
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's graded Gem Mint 10, put it into your hand, otherwise each opponent may draw a card. Go again

unparsedCards.name: Go Bananas
segments: Name an action card. Open and reveal a booster pack of Flesh and Blood and put all cards with the chosen name into your hand. If the booster pack does not contain a card with the chosen name, you may repeat this process.

unparsedCards.name: Taylor
segments: You may have equipment of any class or talent in your inventory. Each equipment in your starting inventory must have a different name.
At the start of your turn, you may banish an equipment you control. If you do, equip a card of the same subtype from your inventory.

unparsedCards.name: Yorick, Weaver of Tales
segments: At the start of the game, all heroes shuffle their starting decks together. All heroes share the same deck and graveyard this game.

unparsedCards.name: Tales of Adventure
segments: Each other hero chooses and creates a token that hasn't been chosen; Aether Ashwing, Embodiment of Earth, Embodiment of Lightning, Ponder, Quicken, Runechant, Seismic Surge, Soul Shackle, Spectral Shield, Zen State.
You create a Copper, Silver, and Gold.

unparsedCards.name: Good Deeds Don't Go Unnoticed
segments: At the start of each other hero's turn, choose 1; they draw a card, they gain {r}, they gain 1{h}, or their next attack this turn gains +1{p}.
At the start of your turn, destroy this. If another hero drew a card from this, you draw a card, then repeat for {r}, {h}, and {p}.

unparsedCards.name: Pink Visor
segments: Once per Turn Action - {r}: The next card you reveal this turn has its grade increased by 1. Go again

unparsedCards.name: Drinking Buddy
segments: When this attacks, each hero may search their deck for an item with Potion or Brew in its name and put it into the arena. Each hero that does, shuffles their deck. If two or more heroes put a card into the arena this way, this gets go again.
